description: Round 33 diagnostic content-script: runs at DocumentStart (HeadParsed) so it wraps fetch/XHR/sendBeacon before the app's bootstrap caches its own references; captures page JS errors, unhandled rejections, console.error/warn, and logs every network call with ms-since-install timestamps into an on-page banner (200 lines) and mirrors every line to console.log with an ERRCAP prefix so the bootstrap chain also lands in the engine log; also reports scheduler/postTask, serviceWorker, visibilityState, probes live IntersectionObserver delivery, logs the Function.prototype.toString identity of window.fetch and XHR open/send at install (native vs YouTube-wrapper discriminator for the R31 player-POST split), logs the first 500 chars plus streamingData/playabilityStatus presence of youtubei/v1/player responses only, and logs the fetch init mode/credentials/cache/referrerPolicy for player calls only (R33). No behaviour change to the page beyond the banner and one sentinel div.
name: R33 Error Capture
